{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Count QA orders
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_clean[(sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue}")

# Print count to verify population
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders (after removing QA orders): {len(loyal_completed)}")"}
